title: Unit Event — Perspective for Smile

meta.Outline: Wonderlands×Showtime has finished training with Shunmeiza, and is set to study stage combat with the Mikazukigumi troupe. How will Emu and the others fare on this new, intensely physical stage?!

rows.Line: Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Everyooone!
Morni-morni-good morning!!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's do our best to make this another wonderhoy day!!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Seriously, how it is possible for anyone to have so much energy in the morning...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Good morning, Emu.
Sounds like you're in an excellent mood again today.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Of course I am! Because today...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We get to start working with a new group!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, that's right...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I can't contain myself regarding the prospect of stepping onto a new stage! It even took me ten whole minutes to fall asleep last night...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, that sounds like a normal amount of time...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. In any case, I think it's safe to say that we're all excited about this opportunity.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Having to say goodbye to everybody from Shunmeiza was kinda sad...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But I'm also really happy we got to learn so much from them!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Me as well. On top of having the privilege of performing in one of their plays, we were fortunate enough to help make a film. Both invaluable experiences by all accounts...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And they gave us such a nice send-off.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa, Emu, Nene & Rui
rows.Line: Thank you very much for having us!

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line:
Yes, thank you for joining us.
But it's sad to see you all have to go like this...

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: However, despite your short stay with us, you showed a tremendous amount of growth.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: You in particular, Tenma.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line:
You still have a lot to learn...
But your talent for truly becoming a character is unquestionable.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: That will surely come in handy moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Th-Thank you very much...!

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line:
For now, farewell.
We'll be looking forward to seeing you all on stage again.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, and we can't thank you enough for everything!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: They were all such wonderful people...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And I'm glad that we got to talk to Bakuno one last time.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It was nice of him to say that he hoped we'd get to perform together again someday.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That means we're all gonna have to get a lot better...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed! We'll need to learn as much as we can as we start working with Mikazukigumi today!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (That means I also have to do my best...!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I have to learn as much as I can about acting and how troupes work and stuff.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (To make everyone in Phoenix Wonderland smile... To make everyone around the world smile!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Still, I have no idea what working with Mikazukigumi is going to involve...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They're known for putting on incredibly entertaining performances that are historical in nature.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They're particularly good at performing stunts and doing sword fights, so their practices may be very demanding physically.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yikes, you're right...
I'm gonna have to do my best to keep up.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: On the other hand, this is a golden opportunity for us to learn how to do stunts and sword fights!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I had a chance to learn a little during a workshop a long time ago, so I'm very much looking forward to this!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, me too! I wanna go all, “Shing!” and, “Hiyah!” and stuff!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, also...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I heard that the current leader of Mikazukigumi founded this troupe when he was still a university student!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, I really wanna hear about how he actually founded this troupe and how he runs it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, excellent!
After all, acting is only a part of our training!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. I can't wait to meet him...

rows.Speaker: Delivery Person
rows.Line: Wh-Whoa!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? What was that?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Look, over there...!
That delivery person on that hill...!

rows.Speaker: Delivery Person
rows.Line: Th-The dolly's getting away...!
se_event_smile_2024_001

rows.Speaker: Delivery Person
rows.Line:
What if it hits someone?!
Also, the packages are gonna get damaged!
se_event_smile_2024_001

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Th-This is bad...!
We need to stop it!
Leave it to me!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?
*Shout*
*Roar*

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Wh-Whoa...
He stopped the dolly. But it was going so fast...!
Phew. Okay, it's stopped...

rows.Speaker: Delivery Person
rows.Line:
Th-Thank you very much!
You're a lifesaver!

No, that's okay!
It was nothing.
I was just putting my muscles to good use!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No ordinary person would be able to do what he just did...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah...
He's got an odd personality too...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But he seems really familiar...
Anyway, farewell! I have to be somewhere!
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, he's coming this way!
You guys are Wonderlands×Showtime, right...?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Y-Yes, we are. Does that mean you're...?

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
I'm Daigo Kijima!
Leader of the Mikazukigumi troupe!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
...!
We weren't expecting the troupe leader to come and meet with us first...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Please pardon us!
My name is Tsukasa Tenma. Thank you very much for allowing us to work with your troupe so suddenly!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Hah hah hah! There's no need to be so formal with me.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Shosuke's told me all about how you're going around to train with different troupes.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What?! You know Shosuke?

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Hm? He didn't tell you?

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: He and I attended the same university. We were studying different things, but met during this one class we both happened to be taking freshman year.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: I couldn't believe it when he came over and asked for my help. He said, “I need you to lend some people I know a hand. I beg you.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We had no idea...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Shosuke...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Umm... We look forward to working with you!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We want to learn as much as we possibly can to make our dreams come true!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We may end up causing you some trouble, but we're still going to do our best...!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Yeah, of course!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: I'm not doing this because Shosuke asked me to. I'm doing this as a troupe leader and fellow actor. I'm here to help young talent such as yourselves grow.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: So, I'm prepared to give you all the support I can!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Mr. Kijima...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: You're welcome! Now, follow me!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
Time to run after that sun in the sky!
After that, your training with Mikazukigumi will begin!
se_run_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Look how far he's already gone.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wait, we're going to get left behind...!
We need to start chasing after him...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wh-Why is running the first thing we're doing...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Just think of it as a way for us to improve our stamina.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Right...
Which means our training has already begun! We should expect no less from Mikazukigumi...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, let's...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: ...do our very best and have a wonderhoy time with our new friends!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, let's!
Mikazukigumi Practice Area

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow, this place is huge...!
It's like a big gym!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So this is where Mikazukigumi practices.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
Yeah, but we rent this place out.
We don't actually own it or anything.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
We are a small troupe, after all.
Shunmeiza has their own theatre, while we find venues to rent for each of our performances.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: And as far as troupe members go, this is just about all of our actors.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
Listen up, everyone!
Wonderlands×Showtime has come to visit us!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
We're Wonderlands×Showtime.
We look forward to working with you all starting today!

rows.Speaker: Emu, Rui & Nene
rows.Line: We look forward to working with you!

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line:
Oh, you guys are here!
We know your stay with us is gonna be short, but we're also really looking forward to working with you all!

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line: You guys have been training with other troupes, right? That's so cool! You gotta tell us all about what you've been doing!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Everyone here seems very friendly...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
Yeah, they're a cheery bunch!
Just relax and be yourselves. There's no need to feel nervous.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh... O-Okay! Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: This is a totally different troupe compared to Shunmeiza...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's great how no two troupes are alike!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Anyway, I'll have everyone introduce themselves a little later. For now, I'd like to discuss what you'll be doing with us...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: During your month with us, I'll be asking you to work with the goal of becoming a part of one of our productions.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: A whole month?

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: That's right. We're currently in the middle of getting our next production together...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: However, we still haven't decided what show to put on, let alone assigned any roles.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: So, depending on what your acting is like after one month with us... I'll be deciding whether to make you all an offer to be a part of it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I see...
You'll be judging our skills based on our performance one month from now.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Exactly.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (So, he's testing us...?)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(Then...
Whether or not we get to be a part of their next production completely depends on how we act a month from now...!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(I wanna be in it!
The others also have to be thinking the same thing!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (So, we all gotta do our absolute best to perform well...!)

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Obviously, we're here to help you, so we're not going to just toss you out onto the street if things don't go well.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: But being included in our production is a different story.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Our goal is always to give our audience the best performances we possibly can. That isn't about to change, and I hope you'll all understand.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
Good! Then, here's the script I want you to work with.
You guys choose which roles you want to play. We'll fill in the rest.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Once you've had a chance to read through it, a few of our members will lecture you on the basics of sword fighting and the sequences for this play.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Finally, at the end of today's practice, I'll have you all run the various climax scenes for each character.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: I know I'm asking a lot, but I'm looking forward to seeing some good results...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Of course!
Several dozen minutes later

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow! This story's so good...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I agree!
A pleasant surprise since I was expecting a much more serious historical drama!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Me as well. I guess it just goes to show that it's hard to miss with Ushiwakamaru.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Ushiwakamaru's real name was Minamoto no Yoshitsune, right...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, Ushiwakamaru was his name in childhood. The story of his life is a dramatic one that's constantly being told and retold even to this day.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And the story in this script is an adaptation of his legend.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really?! That's so cool!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The parts where he and the tengu jump around those mountains, and the way he defeated big ol' Benkei was so awesome!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed! The little guy winning against overwhelming odds... A timeless tale of heroism that everyone loves.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, who's gonna play who?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Good question...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I think Emu should play Ushiwakamaru.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: W-Wait, you want me to be the lead...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. I believe you'll have the easiest time out of all of us achieving a good grasp of Ushiwakamaru.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah...
To be honest, this Ushiwakamaru's kinda tricky because he's such a free spirit. I had a hard time understanding what he was thinking most of the time...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But it's obvious that he likes to have fun and lives true to himself, which are traits that you both share, Emu. You probably won't have any trouble playing him.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You think so...?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
But are you sure...?
I thought either you or Tsukasa would've wanted to play the protagonist...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes... I obviously would like to play him.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But I have to think that there's a reason behind you making this suggestion, Rui...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: There is. Whether or not we get to be a part of this troupe's next production hangs on how this play goes.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Also, it presents us with a new type of challenge.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You mean the sword fighting...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: If so, I feel the same in terms of assigning roles based on compatibility.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The last thing I want is to put on a half-baked performance because I had to frantically juggle acting and sword fighting.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
...
Fair point.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Failure is not an option, and your suggestion may be our best one.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm sorry, Tsukasa, but I'd like to assign roles in a way which more or less guarantees high-quality performances.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Especially since getting to work on a production with the other members of Mikazukigumi would invariably lead to many learning opportunities for us. I hope you understand.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Well...
I agree with what you both just said.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Chasing two hares at once is bound to end in failure, which I'd like to avoid. And I'm sure Emu will do a magnificent job as the lead.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Does that mean...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ushiwakamaru is in your hands, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
You can count on me!
I promise to shine as the coolest Ushiwakamaru ever!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, we'll be looking forward to that!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Then, let's begin assigning our other roles...
Starting with Benkei...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I get to play the lead...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I'm sure Tsukasa and Nene both really wanted to instead...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(But they were willing to let me do it.
They think that'll make for the best performance.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (That means I've gotta do my absolute best!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (We're gonna make this play a big success...!)
A few hours later
Mikazukigumi Practice Area

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Member A
rows.Line: Alright, let's try doing the showdown scene with Benkei at the Gojo Bridge again!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Okay!
Are you ready, Emu...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Ready when you are!
I'm gonna dodge all of your attacks!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Big words!
Then, I'm going to throw everything I have at you!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hiyah!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Here he comes!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (He goes diagonally first, so I need to dodge by squatting... And then I need to jump backwards!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Next, he's gonna start jabbing at me really fast, so I need to twist to my right and...)

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Member A
rows.Line: Stop there!

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Member A
rows.Line:
*Nod*
You two are doing great.
You've basically got that sequence down pat.

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Member A
rows.Line:
Which brings me to the finer details...
Tenma, you need to wield your naginata using your feet more instead of just your arms!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Got it! I'll try improving my footwork.

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Member A
rows.Line: What else is there...?

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: How are things going?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, Mr. Kijima!
You guys came too, Nene, Rui...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We were practicing over there when we got called over. It's apparently time to show the results of today's practice.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Are you two ready, Otori?

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line:
They should be.
They've already been able to memorize the entire fight.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
Really?! That's great!
In that case, please begin once you're ready.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, then... Can I start us off?
I wanna go while everything's still fresh in my head.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay! Break a leg, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line: “Over eight hundred years ago, following the defeat of Minamoto no Yoshimoto at the hands of Taira no Kiyomori, the children of Yoshimoto found themselves in mortal danger.”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Nene's playing Ushiwakamaru's mother, Tokiwa Gozen!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (She bravely protects her children by fighting off the agents of the Taira clan who keep pursuing them.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
“Huff... Huff... Huff...
The Taira clan's henchmen are already here.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
“These children must live on...
They are to carry the Minamoto clan forward. The line must not be extinguished...”

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line: “There they are! After them!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “I'm left with no choice...!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “I was born into a family of warriors. If I must wield a blade to defend these children, then I shall...!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “Hiyah!”

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line:
“Your determination is admirable!
Unfortunately, the Minamoto clan must end here! Prepare yourself!”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “Hiyah!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
He's so light on his feet...!
He really feels like Kurama Tengu. He's captured how powerful Ushiwakamaru's teacher is.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That isn't how I was taught to wield a sword. But I guess a tengu wouldn't use one the same way a human would...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: This is so cool! Rui looks like he's flying!

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line:
“No, he's too strong...
R-Retreat! Retreeeat!”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
“Foolish humans...
Such is your punishment for desecrating these mountains with your filthy footprints...”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Nice work! Now, last but not least...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Right! Me and Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We'll be doing the scene where Ushiwakamaru and Benkei face off at the Gojo Bridge!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
Ah, the climax of this play.
Alright, start once you both feel ready...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Don't worry! You've got a good idea of what Ushiwakamaru's like...!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (The Ushiwakamaru from this story loves to have fun, so it's easy for him to forget about what he was doing whenever he finds something that really excites him...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (All that's left is for me to really immerse myself...!)

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line: “Time would then pass... By the time Ushiwakamaru had turned fifteen, he'd become a warrior in his own right. However, he would also have to choose his path moving forward...”

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line: “Meanwhile, in Kyoto, word of a crazed monk attacking people night after night and robbing them of their swords would begin spreading.”

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line: “And on this fateful night, he would wait at his usual bridge to run into none other than...”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(So it begins.
I'm looking forward to seeing how they move during this scene.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (From what I remember, Ushiwakamaru has to keep dodging Benkei's attacks...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Which leaves such a big impression on Benkei that he feels he can't win and decides to pledge his services to Ushiwakamaru...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(They can't just recite their lines.
They have to also move in a way that makes their characters feel true to life.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “One last sword to complete my collection of a thousand! Tonight, my vow comes to fruition...!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Drop your katana and leave this place!
Only then shall I spare your life!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
“Oh, have you no manners?
Put away that dreadful thing and look up to the sky.”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “See how beautiful the moon is tonight?”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“What nonsense do you speak?!
If you refuse to surrender, then it is my naginata you shall face...!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: *Roar*

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “Hey, now.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Th-That was amazing...
Tsukasa's one thing, but Emu too... She flew so high while jumping backwards...)

rows.Speaker: Mikazukigumi Members
rows.Line: Hey, they're pretty good!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Yeah, they are...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Quit fooling around!
You are a mere child... But if you are going to call yourself a warrior, then unsheathe your katana and fight me!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “Saying that only makes me want to take you even less seriously. Oh, missed me... Missed again...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “You insolent little...!”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (She jumped straight over Tsukasa...!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “What?!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “Hup... There.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Ushiwakamaru slips behind Benkei, takes out his fan and forces his opponent to his knees in shock... The decisive moment.)
